name: Pulse Water Blaster — Single Battery
description: An electric pulse water blaster with a 610 ml tank and one modular battery that slots into the handle. About 58 × 5 × 20 cm. The box has the blaster and a USB charging cable. Water only. Don't aim at faces or animals. Adult supervision for young children.

source.notes: Style code "Standard 2307" (photo label NO.2307, single battery, 610 ml, 58x5x20 cm). Supplier labels the white/orange one 蓝色 (blue) but it is white: listed as White. Photos show a blue light strip on the body, but the supplier text does not mention lights, so the copy does not either. Same 1688 offer (1089431913643) as the rest of the water-blaster range. MOQ unclear: the page says "1 Box starting batch" and lists carton counts of 12-48 pcs, so whether the price is per piece for a 1-piece order or needs a carton is unconfirmed. Prices are per piece from the style list. Store return rate not shown in the screenshots. China freight ¥4/order (note only, not costed). Lithium battery: sea freight only. Realistic firearm-shaped toy: possible customs hold as an imitation firearm, owner to confirm with the clearing agent. Range is stated only on the 2309 box photo (8-10 m, seller figure) and used there; none is claimed for other models. No safety certification shown or claimed. Supplier photos are 800 px (soft once enlarged).
